notes: Versioned model registry for the constrained task router (plan sections 4.2, 9, 16). Entries start as 'not_implemented' because model owners attach the adapters; the router abstains rather than guessing when a required specialist is unavailable. Licence blocks are deliberately unverified until a human has read the exact terms of the downloaded artifact.
